title: VBAUpdater 4.18.7
releaseNotes: Migration baseline for the VBAUpdater self-update channel. This GitHub Release formalizes the already validated V4.18.7 update package. No external customer distribution has occurred yet; fresh-install Setup will become mandatory for the first customer-facing release.

latest.releaseNotes: V4.18.7 corrective release: unified GUI launcher runtime and restored left navigation; Windows PowerShell 5.1 runtime module loading; installer and update Payload user-data exclusion.
